title: The Devil's Contract
text: A devil in a clerk's coat visits every House's tent in turn, the same contract in its hand each time. A boon for you, it says, and a bane for a rival, written out in a neat hand. Each House signs or tears it alone, and nobody will ever know which.

options.label: Tear the contract in half, and trust the others will do the same.

outcomes.text: Every House tore it. The devil sulks off into the dark, its neat hand wasted.
Somebody signed. In the night the bane lands on you like a cold hand on the chest, and you wonder who.

options.label: Sign it, in your own hand. A boon is a boon, and rivals are rivals.

outcomes.text: Only you signed. The boon is real and warm; smiling, the devil folds the paper away, to keep forever.
Others signed too. The banes cancel out, and the devil keeps the difference with thanks to you all.
